map.从 curl 命令提取 URL、方法、Header 与 Body。: Extract the URL, method, headers and body from a curl command.
map.把 curl 命令解析为结构化的请求信息。: Parses a curl command into structured request information.
map.：需正确处理 shell 引号（单/双引号）与反斜杠续行。: : shell quoting (single and double quotes) and backslash line continuations must be handled correctly.
map.：URL、方法、头部、请求体，可转换为 fetch 或 Python reque: : URL, method, headers and body; can be converted into fetch or Python requests code.
map.：含 shell 变量或管道的命令无法静态求值。: : commands containing shell variables or pipes cannot be evaluated statically.
map.把 curl 拆成方法/URL/头/体，便于转代码。: Split a curl command into method, URL, headers and body so it can be turned into code.
map.从浏览器 Network 面板复制 curl 命令，解析出请求方法、头与 bod: Copy a curl command from the browser Network panel, parse out the request method, headers and body, then turn it into an HTTP call in your own project.
map.结合代码生成器可转 requests 片段。: Pair it with a code generator to produce a requests snippet.
map.复制出来的命令带了 --compressed 会有影响吗？: The copied command includes --compressed — does that matter?
map.它只是告诉 curl 自动解压 gzip/br 响应，不改变请求语义，多数 HT: It only tells curl to decompress gzip/br responses automatically; the request semantics are unchanged. Most HTTP clients send the right header and decompress by default, so there is usually nothing to translate. What really deserves attention is the Cookie and Authorization entries in -H — they carry session credentials, so strip them before sharing the command or committing it to a repository.
map.先按「双引号包裹串 / 单引号包裹串 / 非空白串」三种形态做引号感知切词；再按: First split the command into words with quote awareness (double-quoted / single-quoted / non-whitespace); then consume option/value pairs: -X/--request takes the method, -H/--header collects headers, -d/--data variants take the body, -F/--form takes form fields, and -u/-b/-A/-e keep authentication, cookie, User-Agent and Referer semantics. -G/--get appends data to the query string (default GET), -I/--head defaults to HEAD; without explicit -X, data means POST and -T upload means PUT. The first non-option word is the URL. Credentials are masked by default, all output is HTML-escaped, and a structured JSON summary is included.
map.-T/--upload-file 上传文件：仅标记 PUT，文件内容无法静态读取: -T/--upload-file uploads a file: only PUT is marked; file contents cannot be read statically
map.-o/--output 响应写入文件，不是请求字段: -o/--output writes the response to a file; it is not a request field
map.-c/--cookie-jar 仅写出 Cookie 文件，不是请求字段: -c/--cookie-jar only writes a cookie file; it is not a request field
map.-x/--proxy 代理设置，无法静态还原: -x/--proxy proxy setting; cannot be restored statically
map.超时设置，不影响请求内容: timeout setting; does not affect request content
map.TLS 证书设置，无法静态还原: TLS certificate setting; cannot be restored statically
map.--resolve DNS 映射，无法静态还原: --resolve DNS mapping; cannot be restored statically
map.--compressed（响应压缩协商，无法静态还原）: --compressed (response compression negotiation; cannot be restored statically)
map.-G 与 -F 组合：表单字段未自动并入查询串，请人工确认: -G with -F: form fields were not merged into the query string; please verify manually
map.-I 与 -G 同时出现：按 HEAD 处理，数据去向请人工确认: -I with -G: treated as HEAD; verify where the data should go
map.认证/Cookie 已脱敏，请替换 *** 后再运行。: Credentials/cookies are masked; replace *** before running.
map.：URL、方法、头部、请求体，可生成并复制 fetch 或 Python req: : URL, method, headers and body; generate and copy fetch or Python requests code; credentials/cookies are masked by default and placeholders must be replaced.
map.：含 shell 变量或管道的命令无法静态求值；代理、证书、超时、输出文件等无法: : commands with shell variables or pipes cannot be evaluated statically; options that cannot be restored statically — proxy, certificates, timeouts, output files — are listed under “Not included in the request”.
